name: Vientiane International Marathon
short_description: The Vientiane International Marathon takes place on December 6, 2026, at Saphangmo in Vientiane, Laos, offering 42.195km, 21km, 10km, and 5km distances.
ai_summary: The Vientiane International Marathon is scheduled for December 6, 2026, in Vientiane, Laos, based at the Saphangmo venue. The event offers four distance options: a full marathon (42.195km), a half marathon (21km), a 10km race, and a 5km race, giving runners of different experience levels a chance to participate. Registration details have not yet been announced.
pros: Cool race-morning air: 20°C with a 17°C dew point at 6am in 2025
Route past Patuxay and along the Mekong, from the That Luang grounds
Water every 2 km on the organiser's maps
Growing field: more than 7,000 starters from 45 nationalities in 2025
cons: Roads are not closed; the 2024 rules reopen them fully to traffic at 6.30am
Marathoners who miss the 3-hour-30 checkpoint are stopped and bussed back
Entries are non-refundable and, under the 2024 rules, non-transferable
Race packs must be collected in person before race day
